title: r-releaser manifest
description: Metadata sidecar produced by build-src/build-bin, merged by merge-manifests, attached to the GitHub Release as manifest.json, and consumed by deploy-prism. Keys are release asset filenames; values describe the artifact. Runtime validation is implemented dependency-free in shared/manifest-schema.js and must be kept in sync with this file.

sourceEntry.description: Written by build-src for the source tarball. Carries caller metadata (arbitrary scalar fields, e.g. PrismRemoteRef, GitOrigin, GitSHA) used by deploy workflows to resolve provenance.

binaryEntry.description: Written by build-bin per built binary. os_codename embeds the /etc/os-release ID plus major version (e.g. almalinux8) and must map through shared/platforms.json at deploy time. no_sys_deps and glibc_max are written by the portability verifier on linux builds (docs/portability-contract.md); both are absent in manifests from older build-bin versions.
